title: The Intrusion Pathway: How Non-Evidential Context Degrades Language Model Performance
abstract: arXiv:2611.07778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models lose accuracy when a prompt contains non-evidential context: irrelevant statements from unrelated domains, or random off-distribution tokens, with no competing answer and no semantic overlap with the query. Such noise pervades retrieval-augmented, tool-using, and long-context deployments, yet the failure has lacked a mechanistic account. We trace the corruption to the Intrusion Pathway, which starts with MLPs enriching both query-subject and irrelevant-token representations, parroting heads carry prefix-token content to the prediction position, and relational readers largely avoid unrelated sources. Nevertheless, preserved subject enrichment and selective reading do not prevent intrusion in the broader computation. We then localize part of this interference to a sparse set of attention heads, which we call intrusion heads. translated_title: 侵入通路：非证据性上下文如何降低语言模型性能
translated_abstract: 当提示词中包含非证据性上下文时，语言模型会损失准确率：这些上下文包括来自无关领域的不相关陈述，或随机的分布外标记，它们既不包含竞争性答案，也与查询没有语义重叠。这种噪声普遍存在于检索增强、工具使用和长上下文等部署场景中，然而这一失败现象一直缺乏机制层面的解释。我们将这种性能损坏追溯到“侵入通路”：其起点是MLP同时丰富查询主体和不相关标记的表示，随后“鹦鹉学舌头”将前缀标记的内容传递到预测位置，而关系读取器则在很大程度上避免读取无关来源。然而，被保留的主体信息增强和选择性读取并不能阻止更广泛计算中发生的侵入。随后，我们将这种干扰的一部分定位到一组稀疏的注意力头上，我们将其称为“侵入头”。它们源自前缀的写入会促进与干扰物相关的内容，同时它们对……（摘要在此处截断）的支持则有所减少。
tldr: 本文揭示了非证据性上下文（无关陈述或随机标记）降低语言模型性能的内在机制，将其归因于“侵入通路”及一组稀疏的“侵入头”注意力头，这些头将无关的前缀内容写入预测位置从而导致准确率下降。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the mechanistic account of how non-evidential context (irrelevant statements or random tokens) degrades language model performance, tracing the corruption to an "Intrusion Pathway" and a sparse set of "intrusion heads" that promote distractor-related content at the prediction position, thereby reducing accuracy.
